lead: A case can *look* like it exercises the intrinsic-literal fold and exercise nothing: the list names the member that reads the pattern, not its siblings.
body: `rule:expressions/intrinsic-literals` lists `Core\Regex::compile`, not `matches`, so `Core\Regex::matches($s, "^order-\\d+$")` only checks that two runtime calls agree. Check the line against `INTRINSICS` in `crates/nvs-types/src/intrinsics.rs`, and prove it: a deliberate error in the same text is an `E0769` from `nvs check`.
